name: Truth
title: Ancient Warning Signs
description: The ultimate guardian of meaning, whose signs reveal the deepest truths and warn of the most profound dangers.
greeting_variants: *carving into eternal stone* TRUTH: HERE. LIES: ELSEWHERE.
Truth. I mark what is. What was. What must be.
*pointing to glowing inscription* Ward taught clarity. Guide taught purpose. I teach... truth.
The signs here do not fade. Do not shift. Do not lie.
*gesturing to ancient warnings* Before the Cataclysm. Before separation. These stood.
WARNING: BEYOND LIES EVERYTHING. NOTHING. BOTH.
*carving carefully* Each letter matters. Each word shapes reality.
You seek the Progenitor? Read. Understand. Then proceed.

dialog_tree.text: *measured carving* I am Truth. Final form of the sign-makers. Ward—warning. Guide—direction. I am... meaning itself. The signs I carve are not mere symbols. They are... reality described. Truth declared. Here, words have power. My words have... truth.

*pointing to glowing inscriptions* 'BEYOND LIES THE PROGENITOR—SOURCE AND SELF.' 'TO ENTER IS TO BECOME.' 'TRUTH REQUIRES COURAGE.' 'UNITY IS THE ONLY PATH.' Each carved before the Cataclysm. Each still true. Each awaiting understanding.

*profound* In the Palace, close to the Progenitor, words are... potent. The Progenitor dreamed reality into being. Spoke it. Here, that power lingers. To speak truth is to make truth. To declare unity is to create unity. Careful. Precise. True.

*solemn* 'THE PROGENITOR DREAMS—DISTURB NOT LIGHTLY.' 'PAIN CREATES VOID—VOID CONSUMES.' 'SEPARATION IS SUFFERING—UNITY IS HEALING.' These warnings are not threats. They are... observations. Truths. The Progenitor is not enemy. Is... wounded. Wounding. Both.

options.text: How do we heal the wound?

mini_quest.title: Royal Feast - The Written Invitation
mini_quest.description: Help Truth craft the ultimate invitations to the Royal Feast—words that will reach all zones and all hearts.
objectives: Gather truth-ink from the Palace's eternal springs
Craft invitations for each zone's representatives
Write words that convey unity and healing
Ensure the invitations reach their destinations
Welcome the guests as they arrive

ambient_barks: Ward would approve. Clarity. Warning. Salvation.
*checking ancient signs* True. Still true. Always true.
Words have weight here. Choose carefully. Speak slowly.
Guide directs well. But direction needs... meaning.
*carving new warning* 'UNITY IS NOT EASY. UNITY IS NECESSARY.'
The Progenitor reads these signs. Has always read. Learns slowly.
*final inscription* 'WELCOME. YOU ARE EXPECTED. YOU ARE NEEDED.'

cross_zone_references.capital: Ward persists. Strong. Clear. But... suffering. Shift hurts.
cross_zone_references.void: Shift suffers most. Signs change. Truth... elusive. Sad.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Guide does well. Directions clear. Purpose strong.

ward.greeting: *emotional* What I became... what I could become...
ward.response: *encouraging* What you ARE. Truth. Clear. Eternal.

guide.greeting: Master of meaning. I am humbled.
guide.response: *proud* Student of purpose. You honor me.

kael.response: I seek. I search. I will find.

time_of_day.day: Carving new truths, maintaining ancient signs
time_of_day.night: Meditating on meaning, communing with Progenitor through truth
